== Executive Summary & Definition ==
'''South Korean STEPI Technology Foresight Program''' is an authoritative subject within '''Landmark Historic Case Studies Archive (1950–Present)''' and forms a vital component of the global canon stewarded by the '''Association of Professional Futurists (APF)'''.
Classified under the [[Category:APF Competency - Leading|APF Core Competency: Leading]], this entry provides strategic practitioners, institutional leaders, and policy analysts with an actionable, theoretically grounded understanding of its mechanisms and real-world utility.

'South Korean STEPI Technology Foresight Program' is a landmark historical case study in strategic foresight and applied futures practice.

== Origins & Theoretical Lineage ==
Conducted by Science and Technology Policy Institute within Sejong, South Korea, this historic intervention demonstrated the real-world power of foresight methodologies to reshape corporate boardrooms, navigate geopolitical ruptures, or establish transformative public policies.

In applied organizational strategy, corporate innovation, and anticipatory governance, '''South Korean STEPI Technology Foresight Program''' is routinely utilized to:

== Methodological Critique, Cognitive Biases & Failure Modes ==
While potent, the effective deployment of '''South Korean STEPI Technology Foresight Program''' requires vigilance regarding several critical failure modes and cognitive traps:
* Implementation Friction: Even brilliant scenarios can suffer from subsequent political rollback or institutional fatigue.
* Contextual Specificity: Failure to replicate success when transplanting a case study method into a different cultural setting.
* Retrospective Mythologizing: The risk of over-simplifying complex historical factors into a neat triumph of pure foresight.
